name: relight-workspace
description: Convenience scripts; the Electron app lives in app/, the Python backend in backend/

scripts.lint:backend: node scripts/uv.mjs run --no-sync --directory backend ruff check . && node scripts/uv.mjs run --no-sync --directory backend mypy
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:backend && npm run test:backend
scripts.bench: node scripts/uv.mjs run --no-sync --directory backend python -m relight_backend.bench --images ../samples --out ../bench-out
